### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem or friction is. Example: *"I find myself manually repeating agent invariants across multi-repo workspaces..."*

### Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how it empowers your AI harness or coding agent workflows.

### Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Workflow / Ergonomics Impact
How will this improve speed, safety, or smoothness for developers and agents?
- [ ] Faster prompt capture
- [ ] Better context precision / lower token cost
- [ ] Safer invariant enforcement
- [ ] IDE or Agent harness integration

### Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or examples here.
